name: Internet & cloud outages
value: Lloyds app outage 27 Nov; Allstate down 5 days
summary: Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland apps down for hours on 27 Nov; Allstate's site and app down since 23 Nov
state: Thousands of Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland customers could not log in or move money from early on 27 Nov, a payday, with over 4,000 Downdetector reports (City AM); the bank said in the afternoon that services were back up (CX Today). Allstate's US website and app have been down since 23 Nov with no restoration time as of 27 Nov (Gizmodo). A multi-hour payments outage in the past 48h sets Watch.
for_you: If a banking app fails, banks usually offer phone and branch services. Check your bank's official channels for updates and beware of scam messages.
rubric_hit: Major payments outage > 2h in the past 48h (Lloyds, 27 Nov)

sources.title: City AM — Lloyds Bank hit with app outage on Black Friday
CX Today — Lloyds says app and online banking outage is resolved
Gizmodo — Allstate customers still in the dark as tech outage continues

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
